prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen with a two-column layout to present companion choices side-by-side with personality traits and stats.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column"}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Home Intro Screen: Move the sign_in step to occur after home_intro so users experience their interactive desktop pet before account setup.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Story Scroll Flow: Introduce a dynamic story scroll layout on the pet selection screen that reveals pet lore as users scroll through available options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "story_scroll"}}
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Choose Path Journey Welcome Screen: Insert a new introductory screen right after story to set expectations for custom versus preset companion creation paths.
   config: {"story": {"_order": ["story", "new_welcome", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Video Preview Flow: Display an animated video preview of the pet exploring the desktop while generation progress completes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:desktop_pet_preview", "style": "rounded", "action": "play"}]}}
5: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Checklist Layout Refresh: Update the adoption certificate screen to a checklist layout displaying verified pet setup details and adoption parameters.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "checklist"}}
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen layout to a spotlight layout that highlights desktop launch controls and completion buttons.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Two Column Layout: Redesign the initial story screen layout to a two-column view presenting the pet companion welcome narrative side-by-side with app features.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "two_column"}}
8: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Ready Alert: Add an explicit notify toggle and completion status badge to the waiting screen so users know when background generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Ready Alert Enabled", "style": "highlight", "action": "next"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Active Status Display: Add a desktop status indicator badge and explanatory hint text on the home intro screen confirming the pet is running in the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Your pet is active in your system tray. Click its icon anytime to reveal or customize it.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Desktop Pet Active", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of the pick_friend selection screen layout within onboarding.
Reordering sign-in to occur after home_intro is explicitly allowed.
Valid layout redesign for the pet selection screen that retains its core job.
Adding a new welcome screen to onboarding without removing existing steps is allowed.
Adding a video preview component to the waiting screen is permitted.
Replacing the adoption certificate with a checklist layout removes the required official stamp showing the adoption.
Valid redesign of the home_intro spotlight layout within onboarding.
Valid two-column layout redesign for the story screen.
Adding notification controls and status badges to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding status indicators and hint text to home_intro is allowed.
